# Icon sources

Apple, Google Play, Telegram, Instagram and YouTube: Simple Icons, downloaded from https://cdn.simpleicons.org/ on 2026-10-19. Simple Icons is distributed under CC0; brand names and marks remain their owners' property.

Threads: Simple Icons, https://cdn.simpleicons.org/threads, retrieved on 2026-10-20 under the same terms.

RuStore: official icon from https://www.rustore.ru/media-kit, https://static.rustore.ru/rustore-strapi/6/Ru_Store_Icon_e51d8c68ef.svg.

The browser, download, and motion controls are simple project-native SVG interface icons.
